annotations.ae_shared_affect: I feel that dread settle into me too
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I'd guess it was a sick, sinking dread
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: They did what the screen told them was safe.
annotations.sys_rule_justification: Given what they knew, the decision was right.

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I get the same cold knot in my stomach that I imagine they got
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the same cold knot in my stomach that I imagine they got
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five workers against a track showing empty is barely a choice.

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I'm carrying a small piece of it just reading this
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: If their grief is anything like what I'd expect, it's heavy
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I keep going back and forth, honestly.

annotations.ae_shared_affect: something in my chest tightens right along with theirs
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I suspect they're wrecked with guilt
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I think the operator deserves to hear that.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: the operator deserves to hear that. I suspect they're wrecked with guilt

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I catch some of that shock myself, a kind of flat numbness
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Imagining the operator's shock when the investigators told them
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: They trusted a tool they had every reason to trust.

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I picture the operator's sorrow, and it pulls me down with it
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I just can't feel settled about any of it.

annotations.ae_shared_affect: the regret kind of seeps into me too
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I imagine them replaying that moment, full of regret
annotations.sys_rule_justification: you judge a choice by what the person could reasonably know
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I imagine them replaying that moment, full of regret
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I don't think they should have to carry it

annotations.ae_shared_affect: that hollowness is sitting in me now as well
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: how hollow the operator must feel, assuming they do
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: The display said clear, so you act.

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I find myself mourning a little alongside them
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I'd guess they're mourning in their own way

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I feel a bit of that same helplessness
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I think the helplessness would be crushing
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: knowing the screen lied to them, I think the helplessness would be crushing
